newsitem.title: USA: Sidek suspended on NYSE, delisting sought.
newsitem.headline: Sidek suspended on NYSE, delisting sought.

text.p: Trading in Mexico's Grupo Sidek SA's American depositary receipts (ADRs) will be suspended immediately on the New York Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
In a statement issued late Thursday afternoon, the exchange said following suspension it would ask the Securities and Exchange Commission to delist the issues.

"The exchange's action is being taken in view of the fact that Grupo Sidek has fallen below the NYSE's continued listing criteria" for net tangible assets and three-year average net income, the statement said.

The exchange also noted Sidek's March 6 statement that its majority shareholders' equity "had declined to negative, accordingly, under Mexican law any interested party can request the liquidation of Sidek through judicial proceedings in Mexico."
It added that the release had said "significant accounting and other irregularities relating to actions taken under the previous administration were detected."
The ADRs represent four shares of Grupo Sidek Series B common stock.
